title: iberis amara var. decipiens
intro: Iberis amara var. decipiens, commonly known as rockcress, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that can help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of rockcress include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of rockcress include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
